title: Briefportal Leibniz: Ausgewählte Briefe
author: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz and correspondents
institution: Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen with the Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Bibliothek Hannover (Leibniz-Archiv)
region: Germany (Hanover) and the Low Countries, Switzerland
notes: Selected letters from the Akademie edition of Leibniz's correspondence (series III, volumes 5-8): 188 letters in the database, mostly the exchange with Johann Bernoulli, 1692-1701, with variant readings and graphics. Of the 188 letters, 148 are dated 1692-1700, 28 date from 1701 and 12 are undated. The metadata can be downloaded as TEI (adw_goettingen_leibniz_briefportal.xml, CC BY 4.0), but that file holds no letter text; the letters themselves are read in the portal. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
